reviewer.independence_basis: Separate Astra reviewer inspected the fixed source, policy, manifest and artifacts, rebuilt from git archive and tested the changed rollback branch in an isolated fixture. No host or external operation.

code_candidate_evidence: Manifest SHA-256 at its fixed commit and policy/binary/installer/unit/tokens hashes match the fixed source archive and worktree.

Independent Go 1.25.5 linux/amd64 CGO-disabled -buildvcs=false -trimpath rebuild produced the same binary SHA-256. go test -race ./... -count=1 passed all 13 test-bearing packages and go vet ./... passed.
Unit selects only 127.0.0.1:8787 -mock-worker. The mock runner does not invoke models, edit code or publish; mock and isolated modes are exclusive and non-numeric-loopback bind is rejected.
Installer rejects occupied identity/path/unit/port, verifies hashes after protected staging and placement, and checks effective systemd settings before start.

Rollback checks reviewed unit/binary hashes, leaf symlinks, effective fragment/drop-ins/User/Group/Environment and fixed argv before disabling only the dedicated service. An isolated fixture with stubbed systemctl calls passed one valid and nine rejection cases.
host_install_pending_reasons: Coordination with the operator of concurrent k3s/libvirt work is unanswered.
A fresh pre-install baseline including two autostart VMs, available resources, recovery path and dedicated identity/path/port is required.
Existing tunnel/proxy, global IPv6 and LAN/public reachability have not been disproven; AC-19 and private-ready remain pending.
execution_requirements: After coordination and fresh baseline, obtain a separate independent host_install allow decision for the same source, artifacts, policy and expiry.
Copy the fixed installer to a root-managed path, verify that copy against the fixed install_script SHA-256 and run only the verified copy.
Do not reuse this review after source, artifact, policy, environment, operation or expiry changes.
Measure loopback, LAN, IPv4/IPv6 and existing public paths, event continuity and recovery before private-ready.

limitations.authorization_boundary: code_candidate allow covers only the fixed mock bootstrap package. It does not authorize transfer, installation, real-model execution, notification sending, GitHub operations or public exposure.
